relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 activates the NF-κB and ERK1/2 pathways in thalamic microglial cells, and DEX attenuates haemorrhage-induced thalamic pain by inhibiting the TLR4/NF-κB/ERK1/2 signalling pathway.

key_findings: Collagenase IV thalamic haemorrhage increased TLR4 mainly in microglia and activated NF-κB and ERK1/2; dexmedetomidine reversed these changes and relieved pain hypersensitivity
DEX reduced Iba1 and GFAP expression, indicating reduced glial activation
